description: URLs every ForkMesh download approves in the desktop firewall, so sign-in, sync, updates and the relay sockets work before anyone answers a prompt. Each rule is seeded once: a rule someone removes or denies stays that way, and a rule added here in a later release is seeded on upgrade. Keep these to URL patterns on the default relay; everything else asks. Syntax: host/path is one path on any scheme, * matches anything, and dir/* also covers dir.
